name: Atlas
tagline: Pick a place and a year on a 3D globe, and step into a generated 3D world of that moment with a voice guide.
problem: People can read history but rarely feel what a place and time were like.
solution: A 3D globe for choosing a location, a voice guide for choosing the year, a generated 3D world for those coordinates and era with period music during loading, and narration that explains what you see, all inside the app.
demo_moment: Team-described: choose a city and a century, warp in, and walk around while the guide explains.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Makes history immersive rather than read.
A two-person team chained 3D world generation, voice and a globe into one flow.

lessons: Turn the theme (a golden age) into a place the judges can visit.
